title: fix(spec)!: a dashboard that declares two global filters under one name is refused

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9KkaDRBKjsksQZiRDpUqmmU)_
Fixes #29023

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:仪表盘的 `globalFilters` 里两个筛选器同名(无 `name` 时按 `field` 算)现在在所有解析入口被拒收,保存门答 422 `INVALID_METADATA`,报错落在第二个的 `name` 上并点名两个下标和改法。
- 为什么改:同名时看板只画一个控件,输入的值却去筛另一个定义的字段,卡片数字悄悄错了;卡里复现:值 north 落到 `status` 上,卡片读 0。
- 风险与回滚:收窄,带重复名的仪表盘再保存会被拒;仓内作者写的仪表盘重复数为 0。已存的行照常加载,`_diagnostics` 标 `valid: false`。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/duplicate-global-filter-names.ts`(判定与报错文字)、`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`(挂在数组上的 superRefine)、迁移条目 `18.ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name.test.ts`,预期 11 项全绿,其中第三项断言报错位置为 `globalFilters[1].name`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(落地前走一次契约复核)。

## What changes

- `DashboardSchema.globalFilters` refuses two or more entries under one filter key. The key is the entry's `name`, or its `field` when it has no `name` (the same derivation as `globalFilterKey` in `system/i18n-resolver.ts`, which the dashboard schema cannot import without a cycle through `ui/component.zod.ts`; a test holds the two equal). One `custom` issue per repeated key, at the SECOND declaration's `name` (or its `field` when that entry is keyed by `field`), naming the key, every index and the remedy: rename all but one (and every widget `filterBindings` key that meant a renamed one) or delete the copy.
- The predicate and message live in `packages/spec/src/ui/duplicate-global-filter-names.ts`, the shape of `data/duplicate-action-names.ts`. Neither the predicate nor the refinement is exported, so the public surface does not move.
- The refinement is attached to the ARRAY, so `DashboardSchema.shape.globalFilters` carries it into any mirror that spreads the shape (pinned).
- Semantic migration entry `ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused` (step 18), modelled on `ui-dashboard-filter-binding-unknown-refused`: refused with a prescription, no conversion. Which definition keeps the name is the author's call, and an automatic rename would silently unbind every widget that meant the renamed one.
- Ledger: `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains the five sites the array refinement adds (`ui/Dashboard` `globalFilters` and the four installed-package manifest projections; `droppedRefinementSites` 983 to 988). JSON Schema cannot state unique-by-key, so the rule reaches the runtime and not the file, as the ledger records.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ui/dashboard.mdx` (the `globalFilters` describe).
- Changeset `.changeset/29023-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name.md`, `@objectstack/spec` minor, `adr-0087: registered ui-dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name-refused`.
- No forced test edits: no existing test changed.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard-global-filter-duplicate-name.test.ts`, 11 cases: two CONTROL accepts (distinct names; distinct names over the same field), the card's reproduction refused at `['globalFilters', 1, 'name']` with the message's first sentence pinned, unnamed pair located at `.field`, name colliding with another entry's unnamed field, empty `name` keyed by `field`, three declarations (one issue at the second, every index listed), two repeated keys (one issue each), the rule travelling with `.shape.globalFilters`, parity with `globalFilterKey`, and the predicate leaving malformed input to the schema.
- Ablation (spec tests import `src`, so no build leg): deleting the `.superRefine(refuseDuplicateGlobalFilterNames)` line through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` (anchor 1 to 0) turns 7 of 11 red, the seven refusal cases; the four that stay green are the two controls and the two predicate-only cases. Restore verified: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt with an empty `--replacement` was refused by the tool (no mutation landed) and is not counted.
- Save door, measured with a scratch `saveMetaItem` test over the stub engine of `protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` (not committed): the card's body answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with one issue at `globalFilters.1.name` in default, `publish` and `draft` mode, and stores nothing; the distinct-name control saves. A stored row that repeats a key still loads through `getMetaItem`, with `_diagnostics` `valid: false` carrying the refusal.

Round 1 (seat): `Metadata-protocol` amended from `semantic` to `narrowed` on the claim and in the changeset (a refused value is `narrowed`); `origin/main` merged at `0d6d4061` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (no conflict; the branch's regenerated `dashboard.mdx` kept, step 4 rebuilt and `check:generated` reads 14/14 up to date). ## Acceptance notes

- Blast radius, measured on this tree: 95 `globalFilters` arrays across 136 files (examples, packages, skills, docs, ui), 14 with two or more entries, zero repeat a key in authored metadata. One hit is a ui renderer unit test (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/dashboard-filters.test.ts`, "lets duplicate names win last") that feeds `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` directly and never parses through the spec; it stays green and is outside this card (`ui/**` not touched). HotCRM: NOT MEASURED (outside this session's repository scope).
- `packages/lint` `validate-widget-bindings.ts` keys filters by name with later-wins semantics; once the schema refuses duplicates it needs no change, and no gate asked for one.
- The reserved name `dateRange`: a `globalFilters` entry named `dateRange` on a dashboard that also declares `dateRange` is not refused by this rule (the lint resolver lets the later definition win). Out of scope here; reported to the seat.
- `os migrate meta --stored` does not list stored dashboards this refuses: the v18 stored-row listing (`conversions/refused-shapes.ts`) carries a detector for the action-name sibling but none was added here (outside the claim's file surface). Reported to the seat as an option.
